name: Tirol Camp
beschreibung: The Tirol Camp is located in Fieberbrunn in the federal state of Tirol, Österreich. The campsite is situated in an alpine valley setting with views of the surrounding mountains. The atmosphere is quiet and focused on closeness to nature. In the surrounding area, ski areas are available in winter, reachable by public transport or car. In summer, numerous hiking trails through the mountain landscape start from here. The campsite's facilities include pitches for motorhomes and tents as well as sanitary facilities. Guests can expect a location with direct access to sports and relaxing activities in nature.
